summary: Skyasterix reviews the official teaser for the upcoming hero Child of Chaos in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. The teaser reveals a unique Element Switch mechanic allowing Child of Chaos to change elements between Ice, Fire, Necrosis, Poison, and others, paired with strong AoE skill effects. Skyasterix strongly advises players to stop spending Heliolite Dice immediately and save all resources to pull Child of Chaos, aiming for at least Inspiration 2 (I2) as he expects him to be one of the most versatile and powerful heroes in the game.
